about: The AP Human Geography app pages. scripts/build-aphug.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in human-geography/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApHugCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/aphug-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the eight trainers of docs/aphug-spec.md section 6, pre-registered in Phase 0: page human-geography/tools/<slug>.html, script human-geography/assets/tools/<slug>.js, model human-geography/assets/tools/math/<slug>.js (ApHugMath.<camelSlug>), content human-geography/data/tools/<slug>.json, validator scripts/lib/aphug-tool-checks/<slug>.mjs, test scripts/test/aphug-tool-<slug>.test.mjs (docs/aphug-architecture.md, "Tools"). topic is the tool's context topic: the tool is built only when its data file exists and that topic is published. FREE OR PREMIUM is set here and only here: a tool with "premium": "tools" is Premium; model-studio, scale-lab and map-reader carry none and are free (docs/aphug-spec.md section 6; model-studio gates its own Premium parts: free is Explore plus the demographic transition drills).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Human geography practice by unit, topic or skill: map, data, image and text sets, models to build, concepts applied to named places, and answers made specific.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a skill, with map, data, image and text sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your human-geography spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Exams
apps.desc: Timed human-geography unit tests and full practice exams in the May 2027 format: 60 multiple-choice questions, then the three free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the May 2027 format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Human geography free-response practice: three 7-point questions (no stimulus, one, two), each task verb shown, a rubric line a point, a full-credit sample.
apps.card: Three 7-point questions, part by part, with the task verb shown and a full-credit sample.

apps.title: Make it specific
apps.desc: Human geography answers specific enough to score: a named place, the scale, an explanation with its because, and both sides of a comparison.
apps.lede: Write the answer, then check it against the rubric and two model answers: one that earns the point and one that loses it.
apps.card: A named place, the scale, and an explanation with its because, checked against a rubric.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Human Geography cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with timed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition human-geography flashcards built from the glossary and the formulas you must know, by unit and topic.
apps.card: Spaced-repetition cards from the glossary and the formulas.

apps.title: Tools
apps.desc: Human geography trainers: Model Studio, the FRQ coach, the scale lab, the map reader, the population, diffusion, borders and city labs.
apps.card: Trainers and simulators, then the questions about what you saw.

apps.title: Progress
apps.desc: Your human-geography mastery by unit, topic and skill, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and skill.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every human-geography lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For human-geography teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and Google Classroom sharing, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Model Studio
tools.title: Model Studio
tools.desc: Every model the course framework names, built by hand: drag the rings, sectors, stages and tiers into place, apply the model to a real case, then pick out its limits. Graded piece by piece.
tools.blurb: Build every named model by hand, apply it, then find its limits.
tools.lede: Build the model piece by piece, then test it on a real place.

tools.name: FRQ coach
tools.title: FRQ Coach
tools.desc: Free-response parts answered one at a time with the task verb's demand checked: identify, define, describe, explain, compare and explain the degree, each with its rubric line.
tools.blurb: Answer each part the way its task verb asks.
tools.lede: Read the verb first, then write exactly what it demands.

tools.name: Scale lab
tools.title: Scale Lab
tools.desc: Scale of analysis against map scale, and one data set at global, regional, national and local scale telling four different stories.
tools.blurb: Scale of analysis against map scale, at four scales.
tools.lede: Change the scale and watch the pattern change.

tools.name: Map reader
tools.title: Map Reader
tools.desc: Reference and thematic maps: choropleth, dot, graduated symbol and isoline maps, their legends and the patterns they show, always named with a place.
tools.blurb: Choropleth, dot, graduated symbol and isoline maps.
tools.lede: Read the legend first, then name the pattern and the place.

tools.name: Population lab
tools.title: Population Lab
tools.desc: Population pyramids, the stages of the demographic transition, birth, death and natural increase rates, doubling time and dependency ratios, each worked by hand.
tools.blurb: Pyramids, transition stages, rates and ratios.
tools.lede: Read the pyramid, then work out what it means for the place.

tools.name: Diffusion lab
tools.title: Diffusion Lab
tools.desc: Diffusion types and migration on a map: relocation and expansion, contagious, hierarchical and stimulus, push and pull, Ravenstein, step and chain migration.
tools.blurb: Diffusion types and migration on a map.
tools.lede: Watch a trait or a people move, then name how.

tools.name: Borders lab
tools.title: Borders Lab
tools.desc: Boundary types, state shapes, centripetal and centrifugal forces, devolution and the zones of the law of the sea.
tools.blurb: Boundary types, forces, devolution, the sea zones.
tools.lede: Read the boundary's history, then name its type.

tools.name: City lab
tools.title: City Lab
tools.desc: Bid-rent and von Thünen rings, the city models side by side, central place theory and the rank-size rule.
tools.blurb: Bid-rent, von Thünen and the city models.
tools.lede: Place the land uses, then test the model on a real city.
